newsitem.title: USA: Pride platform rig damaged by blowout.
newsitem.headline: Pride platform rig damaged by blowout.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc said Wednesday one of its platform rigs appears to have been severely damaged by a blowout early Tuesday.

The company said the rig is covered by insurance and no material adverse impact to earnings should be experienced. Pride said the rig damaged was one of its 1,000 horsepower offshore platform rigs, drilling on a platform in East Cameron Block 328, about 100 miles south of Cameron, La., in the Gulf of Mexico.
It said all personnel were safely evacuated prior to the fire and there were no injuries..
Pride said it has under construction, in its Houma, La., facility, an identical 1000HP rig that is scheduled for completion by July or August of this year.
